question.prompt: The diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\) of parallelogram \(ABCD\) intersect at point \(O\). Given \(AC=10\), \(BD=14\), and \(AB=6\), find the perimeter of \(\triangle OAB\).

solutions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so \(OA=5\) and \(OB=7\). The perimeter is \(OA+OB+AB=5+7+6=18\).
solutions.title: Half-diagonals and triangle perimeter
